name: doubles-mixer
description: Rotate partners, print court sheets, and score individual standings.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a social doubles schedule with rotating partners for a pickleball mixer, tennis mixer schedule, padel americano or badminton session. Enter 4 to 48 individual player names, courts and rounds, then get a seeded rotation with balanced sit-outs and a partner and opponent fairness summary.

Browse courts by round, enter game scores, and calculate individual wins, losses, draws, points for, points against, point difference and win percent with a stated tie-break order. Download a Letter or A4 PDF with score boxes, a CSV schedule and portable schedule JSON. Optional group A and group B labels make cross-group partners without asking for gender.

For social play. No rating or skill balancing. Does not apply tournament governing rules or make fixed-team brackets. General search is bounded and may leave partner repeats above the reported counting lower bound. Unequal groups can be refused when balanced sit-outs are impossible. Digital names are preserved; printed names use Latin characters and player numbers. Download links include schedule settings; share with intended participants.
defaultPrompt: Make a mixer for Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Erin, Finn, Gray, Harper: 2 courts, 7 rounds, seed 42.
Rotate Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Erin on 1 court for 5 rounds, seed 42; give PDF and CSV.
Check mixer fairness: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Erin, 1 court, 10 rounds.

positive.prompt: Make a pickleball mixer for Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Erin, Finn, Gray and Harper, 2 courts, 7 rounds, seed 42.
positive.expected_behavior: 8 players, 2 courts used, 7 rounds, 14 matches. Partner repeats: 0 (lower bound 0). Highest opponent count: 2. Sit-outs per player: 0–0. The widget shows the result and download controls when files are generated.

positive.prompt: Generate a rotating partners schedule for Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew and Erin, 1 court, 5 rounds, seed 42.
positive.expected_behavior: 5 players, 1 courts used, 5 rounds, 5 matches. Partner repeats: 0 (lower bound 0). Highest opponent count: 2. Sit-outs per player: 1–1. The widget shows the result and download controls when files are generated.

positive.prompt: Check mixer fairness for Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew and Erin, 12 courts and 5 rounds.
positive.expected_behavior: 5 players, 1 courts used of 12, 5 rounds: 5 matches. 1 sit-outs per round, 5 total, 1–1 per player. Partner-repeat lower bound: 0. The widget shows the result and download controls when files are generated.

positive.prompt: Score one doubles match: Alex and Blair versus Casey and Drew on court 1 in round 1; team A 11, team B 7.
positive.expected_behavior: 1 scored games, 0 pending games, 4 individual standings. Leader: Alex, 1 wins, 0 losses, 100.00% wins. Win percent (wins / games), then wins, point difference, points for, then player name. All numeric criteria descend; names ascend by Unicode code point. Tied games count as draws and count in games played. Equal numeric results share a rank; names order those rows.

positive.prompt: Make a doubles mixer for Alex, Blair, Casey and Drew, group A Alex/Blair, group B Casey/Drew, 1 court, 2 rounds, seed 42.
positive.expected_behavior: 4 players, 1 courts used, 2 rounds, 2 matches. Partner repeats: 0 (lower bound 0). Highest opponent count: 2. Sit-outs per player: 0–0. The widget shows the result and download controls when files are generated.

negative.description: Fixed-team brackets are outside scope; do not call the mixer tools.
negative.prompt: Make a single-elimination tennis bracket for eight fixed teams.

negative.description: Rating calculations are outside scope; do not call the mixer tools.
negative.prompt: Calculate player skill ratings from match history.

negative.description: Sport rule advice does not require mixer scheduling tools.
negative.prompt: Explain the serving rules for badminton doubles.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: rotating doubles partners, balanced rests, printable score sheets, CSV, JSON and individual standings.

pl-PL.subtitle: Pary, rotacje i wyniki
pl-PL.description: Zaplanuj towarzyski mikser deblowy z rotacją partnerów i zrównoważonymi przerwami. Pobierz PDF, CSV i JSON, wpisz wyniki i zobacz klasyfikację indywidualną. Dla 4–48 graczy. Bez dopasowywania poziomu gry ani oficjalnych zasad turniejowych. Ograniczone wyszukiwanie może nie osiągnąć dolnej granicy powtórzeń.

de-DE.subtitle: Doppelrotation und Ergebnisse
de-DE.description: Plane einen geselligen Doppel-Mixer mit wechselnden Partnern und ausgeglichenen Pausen. Lade PDF, CSV und JSON herunter und erfasse Ergebnisse für die Einzelrangliste. Für 4–48 Spieler. Keine Spielstärkenanpassung oder offiziellen Turnierregeln. Die begrenzte Suche erreicht die Untergrenze für Wiederholungen möglicherweise nicht.

es-ES.subtitle: Rotación de parejas y puntos
es-ES.description: Organiza un encuentro social de dobles con parejas rotativas y descansos equilibrados. Descarga PDF, CSV y JSON, introduce los marcadores y consulta la clasificación individual. Para 4–48 jugadores. Sin equilibrio por nivel ni reglas oficiales de torneo. La búsqueda limitada puede no alcanzar la cota inferior de repeticiones.

fr-FR.subtitle: Rotation en double et scores
fr-FR.description: Organisez une rencontre conviviale en double avec changement de partenaire et pauses équilibrées. Téléchargez PDF, CSV et JSON et saisissez les scores pour le classement individuel. Pour 4 à 48 joueurs. Sans équilibrage de niveau ni règles officielles de tournoi. La recherche limitée peut dépasser la borne minimale de répétitions.

ja-JP.subtitle: ダブルスの組み合わせと個人成績
ja-JP.description: 交流目的のダブルスでパートナーを交代し、休憩回数を均等にします。PDF、CSV、JSONをダウンロードし、スコアを入力して個人成績を確認できます。4〜48人に対応。実力調整や公式大会規則には対応しません。探索回数が限られるため、ペアの重複数が下限を上回る場合があります。

pt-BR.subtitle: Duplas rotativas e resultados
pt-BR.description: Organize partidas sociais de duplas com troca de parceiros e descansos equilibrados. Baixe PDF, CSV e JSON, insira placares e consulte a classificação individual. Para 4–48 jogadores. Sem equilíbrio por nível ou regras oficiais de torneio. A busca limitada pode superar o limite mínimo de repetições.
